en: Black-and-white postcard view over a large complex of multi-storey brick buildings with tiled roofs, laid out around internal courtyards. The caption at the bottom identifies the site as the Saxon State Police School in Meissen and its officials' houses (Blocks I and II). The complex is surrounded by trees and fields, with a broad rural landscape and distant town and factory chimneys visible on the horizon. A red handwritten reference number is visible at the top right.
